title: AI PR review verdict
description: Machine-readable result of the automated PR review. The gate step blocks the merge when critical_count > 0; warnings are informational only.

critical_count.description: Number of CRITICAL findings (security holes, data loss/corruption, broken production logic, or any unguarded change to auth/payments/data-deletion). Any value > 0 blocks the merge.

warning_count.description: Number of WARNING findings. Informational; never blocks a merge.

findings.description: One entry per finding, mirrored as an inline PR comment.

summary.description: One short paragraph: the merge verdict and why.
